messages:
Ava: Heads up — my parents are dropping off an orchid and a small boxed cake at the lobby around 3:20. Can Front Desk tag it as fragile?
Front Desk: Hi Ava — yes. Ask courier to check in and we'll put a fragile sticker and put it in temporary locker 7. Please label who to hand it to.
Ava: Label for 'Jin Park' and 'Ava R.' Also they'll need a visitor badge for Jin at ~3:30.
People Ops: Noted. I'll pre-create a 30-min visitor badge for Jin Park so check-in is quick. Do you want a hotdesk reserved near the lobby?
Marco: I can give up my hotdesk 3A after 2:30 if that helps — chair has a loose wheel though.
Ava: That would be amazing, thanks Marco. If someone can push the wobble-tuning aside, I'd prefer a chair with armrests.
Tom: If the cake arrives, front desk can't refrigerate per policy. Dina or someone will need to grab it to keep it from melting. :cake:
Dina: I can take it to the small fridge by the pantry for 30–45 mins. Happy to be mail/package runner.
Front Desk: Perfect — locker 7 reserved. Courier told to leave package tag and we'll hand to Dina after check-in.
SecurityBot: Visitor Jin Park pre-approved. Badge code: vativ-visitor-032. Camera alerts enabled for arrival window 3:15–3:45.
Ava: Thanks all! Quick poll — do you want the meetup to use the lobby couch or the conference huddle for 15 mins? Reply 'couch' or 'huddle'.
Marco: couch
Tom: huddle
Dina: couch
People Ops: Poll update — couch = 2, huddle = 1. Couch wins; reserved 15-min slot.
Ava: Awesome. I'll meet folks at the lobby couch at 3:30. Thanks everyone and special thanks to Dina and Marco. :thumbsup:
Front Desk: We'll log handoff in the package spreadsheet and leave a sticky on locker 7.
Ava: ETA update — they're running 5 min late, should still be in window.
SecurityBot: Noted. Camera will keep an extra 15s clip at check-in per request.
Ava: All good — see you in 10.
